policy.daily_cap_semantics: same UTC per-voter KTC cap enforced by ktc_pipeline.py
policy.guest_identity_guardrail: guest ids are stable browser-local ext_* identifiers, not verified unique people; guest influence is therefore discounted and capped
policy.market_scale: rank-preserving quantile map onto the current Fundamental Value distribution for the exact resolved market-covered universe
policy.package_vote_rows: excluded before all KTC market processing
policy.voter_weight_formula: min(1, cap/raw_count_for_voter) * group_multiplier; league multiplier=1.0, guest multiplier varies by sensitivity setting
